translations.web: His cheeks are like a bed of spices with towers of perfumes. His lips are like lilies, dropping liquid myrrh.
translations.bsb: His cheeks are like beds of spice, towers of perfume. His lips are like lilies, dripping with flowing myrrh.
translations.kjv: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.
